title: Count threshold crossings in a window
instructions: Implement countAtLeast(values, from, to, threshold). The half-open window contains indices from through to - 1. Return how many values in that window are at least threshold.
Use one loop and a local accumulator. Keep the input array unchanged; explain why to may equal values.length.
